start.name: Tunnel Beach car park
start.quote: The car park is at the end of the road.

end.name: Tunnel Beach
end.quote: A short tunnel with steps leads down to Tunnel Beach.

evidence: Return to the car park the same way you came.
Continue past the first viewpoint and down to the spectacular rocky coastline. A short tunnel with steps leads down to Tunnel Beach.
From Blackhead Road, take the signposted turnoff to Tunnel Beach Road. The car park is at the end of the road.

ways.label: Car park to viewpoint

end.name: first viewpoint
end.quote: Follow the well-formed path to the first viewpoint

evidence: For an easy walk, stop at the first viewpoint and enjoy the view.
Follow the well-formed path to the first viewpoint for dramatic views of the headland, coastline and a natural rock archway.

access_points.name: bus stop at 292 Middleton Road, Corstorphine
access_points.quote: the closest parking is by the bus stop at 292 Middleton Road, Corstorphine
access_points.onto: Tunnel Beach Road (footpath to the track entrance)

doubts: Start taken as F1 (where Tunnel Beach Walkway meets Tunnel Beach Road), matching 'The car park is at the end of the road.' W2 time/distance come from the line '600 m / 10 min (return)', split into its parts. The Middleton Road bus stop is alternative parking reached by a 25 min road footpath walk to the track entrance; it is listed as an access point but is not on a track.
